neighbor_and_dependency_review: PL01 stopping without a signal is now explicitly one challenge rather than an incomplete description of the entire finale. Surrounding factory joke remains coherent.

No collateral change to metadata, distinct article openings, fixed campaign wording or three-different-days framing.
overall_assessment: Substantive upgrade sustained: concrete domestic scenes, two distinct reader intents, adult-facing humour and useful practical information. No unresolved native-language or register defect in the reviewed final scope.
